title: Predictions for Identified Hadron (π±, K± and p(p)) Production and Collective Dynamics in Oxygen–Oxygen Collisions at √ sNN= 7 TeV with EPOS4, AMPT-SM, and Angantyr in PYTHIA 8
content: We study the dynamics of identified hadrons ($\pi^\pm$, $K^\pm$ and $p(\overline{p})$) production in $O+O$ collisions at $\sqrt{s_{NN}}$= 7 TeV using recently updated version of EPOS4, string melting version of A Multi-Phase Transport Model (AMPT-SM) and Angantyr model, incorporated within Pythia 8. We examine the interplay between different mechanisms implemented in these models. Predictions for charged particle multiplicity (\dndeta), transverse momentum ($p_T$) spectra of identified hadrons, particle yield ($dN/dy$) and mean transverse mass ($\langle m_T \rangle$) are presented. To probe the collective behavior of the produced particles, the $p_T$-differential kaons-to-pion and proton-to-pion ratios are studied. While AMPT incorporates some flow effects, EPOS4's implementation of full hydrodynamic flow proves significantly more effective. In contrast, the flow effects in  Pythia 8 are substantially weaker compared to the other models. The upcoming \$O+O$ data from the LHC will help constrain the parameters of these models.
